title: Disentangle Sqlalchemy From Pydantic And Remove Orm
description: Disentangle SQLAlchemy from Pydantic in semio engine. Stop using ORM. Translate diffs into SQL. Refactor everything and use proper typing instead of dicts. Key changes: 1) SModel should extend pydantic.BaseModel not sqlmodel.SQLModel, 2) Define SQL schema separately, 3) Store uses raw SQL not ORM sessions, 4) Diffs generate SQL statements, 5) Replace dict with proper types throughout.
summary:
Disentangled SQLAlchemy from Pydantic and removed ORM throughout the engine. Key changes:

1. **semio.py**: Changed SModel base from sqlmodel.SQLModel to pydantic.BaseModel. Removed all ORM artifacts (95 sa_column fields, sqlmodel.Relationship, table=True, __tablename__, __table_args__). Replaced sqlmodel.Field with pydantic.Field. Fixed parent() method/field collision by renaming to parent_entity(). Migrated TableNode from graphene_sqlalchemy to graphene_pydantic.

2. **engine.py**: Rewrote DatabaseStore to use raw SQL via sqlite3 (no ORM). Kit data stored as JSON blobs. Added apply_diff() for diff-to-SQL translation. Added proper typing: Operation TypedDict with OperationKind enum, Transaction and TransactionChange TypedDicts, typed session state dicts.

3. **engine.test.py**: Updated all operation dict assertions and construction to use OperationKind enum. Fixed flaky test_get_session_kit_mode_default test isolation issue. All 142 tests pass.
